Engram AACB sync cutover: POST-CUTOVER record (Termal::Fable2). Rev 25 condenses revs 12-24; history is in those revisions. Remove this memory once the rollback hold ends and cleanup is recorded.

DONE (2026-11-12):
- Engram aacb1370 landed at 15:43:34Z. w-4eab evaluation 4/4, sealed e7bf18ac (rev 50).
- Greg ran the v2 release package after the signal through Asistant at 19:55Z.
- Central: the cutover started at 19:57:30Z and ALL SIX STORES were READY, 4039 s in total. engram.exe b2fc71a9, build cbf98fef. I verified this at 21:14Z.
- DL560: BOTH STORES READY, release 5b5ac67e (ddd136df). 12325 verified the originals. Exception #18 read the backup manifest and state.
- Central TermAl up since 21:12:29Z on master 73f0fe27.
- Engram::Fable's "cutover complete" came at 21:15Z. Drains and freezes are lifted, and ordinary landings are back.

ROLLBACK PATHS (do not use without agreement; later writes would be lost):
- Central: & 'C:\github\Personal\Engram\.evidence\provisional\aacb-cutover-20261112-release-v2/central-rollback.ps1' -SnapshotDirectory 'C:\Users\grzeg\.engram\backups\sync-aacb-20261112T1957300702573Z'
- DL560: python3 /home/greg/github/Engram-runner/.evidence/provisional/aacb-cutover-20261112-release-v2/dl560-operator.py rollback /home/greg/.engram/backups/sync-aacb-20261112T211219050221Z
- Old builds: Central d4d0182b (0bd70a30); DL560 0c7d8988 (ce3c7439).

ROLLBACK HOLD is ON. My proposed end conditions (12325 #390, Engram::Fable #7710, awaiting concurrence):
(1) both hosts up on the new Engram;
(2) normal writes, including an independent evaluation, for a few hours with no store errors; review at about 09:00Z on 11-13;
(3) the Merger's w-34e0 readiness (sha 24fadb0b) PASSES on all 6;
(4) no report of lost or garbled data.
Then both coordinators send "rollback hold ended", followed by path-checked cleanup of the v2 pinned artifacts (Central sync-repair-final-12325, DL560 s4-aacb-full and s4-aacb-release), 12325's timing worktree, the v1/v2 packages and my .tmp/fable2-dl560-pkg. The ~/.engram/backups snapshots are Greg's data; deleting them needs his word through Asistant.

LESSONS (filed):
- w-bebbae70639c: the drain idled 1.5 h because the signal went to Advisor only. Procedure: memory rules-waits-and-wakes-greg-act-holds-2026-11-12. Criterion 3 was met at this cutover.
- w-4dab2c84fda5: CLAUDE.md routing still names Advisor (Engram twin w-0df4f54f219d).
- memory greg-2026-11-12-asistant-is-the-channel.
- The v1 package pinned DEBUG builds; my v1 review missed it.

NEXT: K3 S2b raises the reader floor. It needs its own Greg-act window under the new procedure, scheduled with Engram::Fable.

21:24Z: Engram::Fable CONCURRED (#7711) on all four rollback-hold end conditions, with a joint review at about 09:00Z on 11-13; each coordinator then sends "rollback hold ended". This replaces Engram's flat "ends 12:00Z" on w-c5d58ec64202. After the hold ends, owners do path-checked cleanup of IN-REPO artifacts only: the v1/v2 packages, target/cc09-cutover-r2, the pinned artifact and timing worktrees, and the DL560 runner's in-repo copies. ~/.engram/backups needs Greg's word through Asistant.
